text:
deploybot: Deploy started — env=production, release=release-2026-10-03, tag=v2.14.0-db-partition, commit=af3c9b2. Running 3 migrations: add_partition_keys, backfill_user_shards, index_user_shard_id.
sam: Copy. I'm watching canary traffic (10% us-west).
deploybot: Migration 'add_partition_keys' started. job_id=mig-7890, parallel_workers=8, started_at=2026-10-03T15:20:56Z
jonah (db): Seeing a deadlock on worker 3 during backfill rows -> SQL error: DEADLOCK DETECTED. Retrying attempt=1.
deploybot: Worker 3: ERROR: DEADLOCK DETECTED, sql_state=40P01, attempt=1
jonah (db): Retried twice, now attempt=3 — still failing and holding row-level locks on shard_04. Tail latency spiking to ~1.2s for writes.
mike-sre: :warning: If we let it run it'll escalate. Suggest pausing that migration and continue the rest of the deploy. Can we rollback that specific migration safely?
asha (eng-release): What's the risk to the app if we pause? Any required migrations blocked?
jonah (db): add_partition_keys only adds partition keys and does backfill; schema change itself was applied with ADD COLUMN but backfill is the problematic step. We can abort backfill and rollback partial rows with the rollback_sql we prepared.
sam: Change window ends in ~30m. We should avoid user-impacting tail latency. I vote pause backfill now and proceed with remaining deploy steps. @oncall-bot escalate if anything else.
oncall-bot: PagerDuty incident created PD#1234 for prod DB deadlock tracing.
sam: Action: pause migration mig-7890, apply rollback_sql to undo partial backfill, mark migration as deferred. Then continue with code rollout and indexes.
deploybot: Migration 'add_partition_keys' paused and rolled back. job_id=mig-7890, rollback_applied=true, rollback_sql_id=rb-3344
asha (eng-release): Noted. Pinning release to commit af3c9b2 and continuing non-migration deploy steps. Will add follow-up ticket to reschedule backfill during low-traffic window (recommended window: 02:00-04:00 UTC). Ticket: INT-4521.
jonah (db): For the rescheduled run: reduce parallel_workers to 2, increase lock_timeout to 5s and enable retry_backoff=exponential. I'll run a staging dry-run tonight.
mike-sre: Thanks — I'll add DB slow query monitors for the backfill job and an SLO override during the maintenance window.
deploybot: Deploy finished (status=completed_with_deferred_migrations). affected_migrations=[add_partition_keys]
sam: Logs & deploy summary: https://internal.redwood/deploys/1801203456 (contains commit af3c9b2, canary=10%)
jonah (db): I'll run the tuned migration in staging at 22:00 UTC and schedule prod run in the maintenance window tomorrow. Will post follow-up results here.
mike-sre: :thumbsup:
asha (eng-release): Thanks all — rolling release notes updated and INT-4521 created. Closing thread.
